name: Chromatic GraphQL API
tagline: GraphQL API for visual regression builds, tests, and review state in Storybook CI.
description: Chromatic is a visual testing and review platform for UI components, typically paired with Storybook. Its GraphQL API lets developers and agents query builds, tests, and review status for component CI workflows.

auth.details: Project token or personal access token (verify exact header/body method from official docs).

example.request: curl -X POST https://www.chromatic.com/graphql -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' -d '{"query":"{ __typename }"}'

use_cases: list recent Chromatic builds for a project
get visual test results for a build
check review/approval state of a component set
query build status in a CI pipeline
